items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Of course, one of the most famous ones that Art really liked was the one in Cleveland, Val's.

ctx.x: Yes sir -- many wonderful evenings and mornings and early mornings with Art in Toledo and some of his friends, and in one of the places where he used to like to play the piano so much, and they served beer -- beer was his specialty, ice cold beer in --
No, that's in Cleveland, I'm talking about Toledo now.
